name: Kagi MCP
tagline: Premium web search with no ads and no tracking from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Kagi MCP server. Lets your agent run Kagi's premium web search — ad-free, no tracking, high-quality results, with optional LLM-enriched summaries. The best ad-free search API.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Kagi MCP server, by Kagi Inc. Exposes Kagi's search API as MCP tools: web search, news search, and the Universal Summarizer (LLM-enriched result with citations). Kagi is the only major search engine that's both ad-free and not driven by ad ranking.

## Why we recommend it

Kagi delivers noticeably better results than Google for technical queries, returns fewer SEO-spam sites, and the Universal Summarizer is essentially a free, cited LLM summary of the top results. The MCP wrapper means your agent can use it for high-quality research without ads polluting the result set.

## When to use it

- Research tasks: agent pulls high-quality, ad-free results
- Citation-rich answers: agent uses the Universal Summarizer for sourced output
- Privacy-sensitive agents: no tracking, no ads
- Technical queries: Kagi indexes GitHub, Stack Overflow, and docs well
installInstructions:
1. Subscribe at https://kagi.com/ (free trial available)
2. Get an API key at https://kagi.com/settings?p=api
3. Set `KAGI_API_KEY=...`
4. `uvx mcp-kagi`

**Pricing note:** Kagi is paid ($5/mo for the basic plan, $25/mo for professional). The MCP server itself is free.
pricingDetails: Free. Kagi requires a paid subscription ($5-$25/mo). The MCP server is open source.
